task_description.overview: Identify and remove 'bad channels' in DAS data based on abnormal signal amplitudes to ensure data quality.
steps: Load DAS waveform data matrix (channels × time samples).
Compute amplitude statistics for each channel.
Detect channels with abnormally low or high amplitudes compared to neighbors or thresholds.
Output lists of good and bad channels.
Optionally remove bad channels from the data section object.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Perform channel quality checking on DAS data from {data_path} with channel spacing {dx} and sampling frequency {fs}. Use the `daspy.advanced_tools.channel.channel_checking` function to check the channel quality. Save the good_channels and bad_channels index to {result_data.save_name} with content {result_data.content}. Plot a figure to show the maximum amplitude of the good and bad channels (use different colors for good and bad channels) and save it to {result_figure}.
